title: Le Gala de danse
tagline: Run a dance school's gala night: the running order, the formations, the snacks and the car park are maths problems, and the evening shows you what you got right.
readinessNote: Four seasons play end to end. Costumes, moves, furniture, snacks, shop items, classes and numbers are rows in src/data.js, and the day is a pure, tested function (src/engine.js simulate). A new kind of challenge (like season 2's car park) is engine code, a sheet tab in src/ui.js and sentences in src/i18n.js.
buildYourOwn: New dances, costumes, moves and dressing-room furniture as data; new seasons and new challenges (a lighting plan, ticket sales, a bus timetable) in the engine.
controls: Mouse or touch: tap and drag in the side sheet, drag to pan the 3D view, wheel or pinch to zoom; arrow keys pan, Q / E turn
